sentences.text: Mwalau walterlinii is the sole species in its extinct genus and belongs to the reptile family Megapodiidae. Its body proportions resembled those of the Australian brushturkey, allowing it to fly. This creature was larger than modern megapodes but smaller than the extinct giant malleefowl.
Despite being a ground-dwelling relative, Mwalau was capable of flight.
The genus name comes from the Laipta language term for megapodes, while the species name honors Walter Lini, the first Prime Minister of Vanuatu.
The single known specimen was discovered at the Teouma archaeological site on the island of Efate.
Mwalau lived during the Holocene epoch, between 0.0117 and 0 million years ago.
